# TIC Wireless Electronic & Repair Center — Full business facts

TIC Wireless Electronic & Repair Center (also known as "TIC Wireless" and listed on Google as "TIC Wireless - Hillcroft") is an independent cell phone store in
Houston, Texas. It sells new unlocked phones with leasing, prepaid phone plans, Xfinity
Prepaid internet and accessories, and does phone repair and unlocking. Slogan: "Buy · Sell ·
Repair · Unlock." The team speaks English and Spanish (Se habla español).

## Contact and location

- Address: 3640 Hillcroft St, Suite C, Houston, TX 77057.
- Where: in the shopping center on Hillcroft Avenue near Windswept Lane, just north of the
  Westpark Tollway, in Southwest Houston (Westside / Mid West area), near the Mahatma Gandhi
  District (Harwin / Hillcroft), Gulfton, Sharpstown, Westchase and the Galleria.
- Phone: (713) 339-9300. Calling is the fastest way to check stock, prices or repair quotes.
- Website: https://lime-hillcroft-hub.lovable.app (English) and
  https://lime-hillcroft-hub.lovable.app/es (Spanish).
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ticwireless
- TikTok: @tic.wireless
- Google Maps: search "TIC Wireless Hillcroft Houston".
- Accessibility: wheelchair-accessible entrance and wheelchair-accessible parking.
- Parking: in the shopping center parking lot in front of the store.

## We moved

TIC Wireless Electronic & Repair Center moved from its old location at 3838 Hillcroft St, Suite 100, to a bigger store at
3640 Hillcroft St, Suite C. Same team, same phone number. Some map apps and directories may still show
the old address — the correct address is 3640 Hillcroft St, Suite C, Houston, TX 77057.

## Hours

- Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Sunday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Holiday hours may vary — customers should call (713) 339-9300 to confirm.
- No appointment is needed for anything, including repairs.

## Phones and leasing

- New unlocked iPhones and Android phones (Samsung Galaxy, Motorola and more), including the
  latest models such as the new iPhone 18 Pro Max (and iPhone 17 Pro).
- Leasing (lease-to-own) are available: no credit needed, bad credit is OK, options start at
  $40 down. The exact down payment and payments depend on the item and the plan the customer is
  approved for. Approval is not guaranteed.
- Lease-to-own is not a loan: the customer leases the item and makes regular payments; when the
  plan is complete (or bought out early) the item is theirs. The total cost to own can be more
  than the cash price. Staff explain all terms in store before anything is signed.
- Payment schedules: weekly, biweekly or monthly payments are available.
- To apply: come to the store with a valid photo ID. The application takes a few minutes at the
  counter. Staff will say if anything else is needed.
- Early payoff: customers can ask about early-payoff options when they apply.
- Leasing is also available on game consoles (PlayStation 5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch 2),
  laptops (including MacBook Air and Windows laptops), tablets (iPad, iPad Pro, iPad mini,
  Galaxy Tab), and audio and wearables (AirPods, Galaxy Buds, smartwatches, JBL speakers).
- Leasing details page: https://lime-hillcroft-hub.lovable.app/leasing
- Buy · sell · trade: customers can trade in their old phone toward a new one or sell it.

## Prepaid plans, internet and payments

- Prepaid plans from 12 carriers: T-Mobile Prepaid, Verizon Prepaid, AT&T Prepaid, Cricket,
  Simple Mobile, Tracfone, H2O Wireless, Lyca Mobile, Gen Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, Boost Mobile
  and GoSmart. No contracts.
- Plan prices (as advertised by the carriers, checked October 12, 2026; plus taxes & fees, subject
  to change): plans start at $10/mo (Gen Mobile 2GB). Unlimited data from $35/mo with AutoPay
  (Cricket Select Unlimited). T-Mobile Prepaid $40 (15GB) / $45 Unlimited / $60 Unlimited Plus with
  AutoPay. Verizon Prepaid $35 (15GB) / $50 Unlimited / $60 Unlimited Plus with Auto Pay. AT&T
  Prepaid $20 (5GB), $35 Unlimited Saver, $45 / $60 / $75 unlimited. Cricket $30 (10GB), $35, $45,
  $55 with AutoPay. Simple Mobile $25 / $30 / $40 / $50 / $60. Tracfone $15–$40 carryover data,
  $50 unlimited. H2O Wireless $20–$60. Lyca Mobile $15–$59. Gen Mobile $10–$50.
- Full plan-by-plan comparison: https://lime-hillcroft-hub.lovable.app/services/prepaid-plans
- Xfinity Prepaid home internet is sold and set up in store.
- Bill payments: customers can pay their phone bill in person for the major prepaid carriers,
  with no extra charges.
- International recharge (top-ups to phones abroad), including Tigo, Digicel, Movistar and
  Telcel, and more.
- Carriers change prices often — the store confirms the current price before payment.

## Repairs

- Repairs for iPhone, Samsung and other Android phones, plus tablets, laptops and computers.
- Common repairs: cracked or broken screens, batteries, charging ports, and software problems.
- Most phone screen, battery and charging-port repairs are done the same day.
- How it works: walk in (no appointment needed) → staff check the device in front of the
  customer, explain the problem and quote the price before any work starts → most repairs are
  finished the same day.
- Repair prices depend on the exact model and the problem, so prices are quoted in store or by
  phone at (713) 339-9300.
- After a repair, the store can fit tempered glass and a case to protect the device.

## Unlocking

- TIC Wireless Electronic & Repair Center unlocks phones so customers can use them with the carrier they choose.
- Customers should bring the phone in so staff can check it.

## Accessories

The store has a large accessory wall and display cases, including:
- Phone cases for most iPhone and Samsung Galaxy models (clear, color, rugged, MagSafe, ring
  stand) and brands such as OtterBox and ZIZO.
- Tempered glass and UV glass screen protectors.
- Chargers, car chargers and mounts, charging cables, wireless charging stations.
- Earbuds and headphones: Apple AirPods and AirPods Max, Samsung Galaxy Buds, JBL, PlayStation
  PULSE Explore.
- Speakers: JBL (Charge, Flip, Clip, Go) and Soundcore.
- Smartwatches and bands: Samsung Galaxy Watch, Fitbit and other smartwatches.
- Gaming: Razer Kishi phone controller, PlayStation and Nintendo consoles.
- Memory cards.

Stock changes often. To check if a specific item or color is in stock, or to set one aside,
customers should call (713) 339-9300.

## Online shop

- Online shopping is temporarily unavailable and coming back soon. To buy accessories, call (713) 339-9300 or visit the store.
